answer: Fresh names must buy their way in with audited labour, not capital alone. A recruit completes twenty-nine reviewed jobs, escrows 160 units for two epochs, and earns four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never intersect. Cloning repeats every audit and posts a separate lock, and a disproved job forfeits it. Because receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be recycled, borrowed standing is empty, so each added identity costs more than the weight it can carry. nadir relic saffron
